WITH availability_with_lag AS 
(SELECT availabilities.resource_id AS resource_id, availabilities.taken_by AS taken_by, availabilities.from_date AS from_date, availabilities.to_date AS to_date, coalesce(lag(availabilities.to_date) OVER (PARTITION BY availabilities.resource_id, availabilities.taken_by ORDER BY availabilities.from_date), availabilities.from_date) AS prev_to_date 
FROM availabilities 
WHERE availabilities.resource_id IN (%(resource_id_1_1)s::UUID) AND availabilities.from_date >= %(from_date_1)s AND availabilities.to_date <= %(to_date_1)s), 
grouped_availability AS 
(SELECT availability_with_lag.resource_id AS resource_id, availability_with_lag.taken_by AS taken_by, availability_with_lag.from_date AS from_date, availability_with_lag.to_date AS to_date, availability_with_lag.prev_to_date AS prev_to_date, CASE WHEN (availability_with_lag.from_date = availability_with_lag.prev_to_date) THEN %(param_1)s ELSE %(param_2)s END AS new_group_flag, sum(CASE WHEN (availability_with_lag.from_date = availability_with_lag.prev_to_date) THEN %(param_3)s ELSE %(param_4)s END) OVER (PARTITION BY availability_with_lag.resource_id, availability_with_lag.taken_by ORDER BY availability_with_lag.from_date) AS grp 
FROM availability_with_lag)
 SELECT grouped_availability.resource_id, grouped_availability.taken_by, min(grouped_availability.from_date) AS start_date, max(grouped_availability.to_date) AS end_date 
FROM grouped_availability GROUP BY grouped_availability.resource_id, grouped_availability.taken_by, grouped_availability.grp ORDER BY start_date
